levels_tested.status: unstable - all connections dropped after peak, cluster disruption

pod_restarts.note: bff-java restarted once during 1000 CCU test due to probe timeout under load

root_cause_analysis.primary_bottleneck: gateway-go single pod (512Mi memory limit) cannot sustain 1000+ concurrent WebSocket connections on single-node VM
root_cause_analysis.secondary_issue: Session ID collision bug - timestamp-based session IDs (sess_<unix_ms>) collide under concurrent creation, causing 403 Forbidden errors
root_cause_analysis.cluster_impact: 1000 concurrent WS connections + heartbeat traffic overwhelmed gateway-go, causing bff-java probe timeout and restart
root_cause_analysis.single_node_constraint: Cannot scale gateway-go to multiple replicas effectively - CPU contention degrades per-pod performance

attempted_solutions: JWT minting instead of BFF register (eliminated email collision under load)
403 retry logic (up to 3 attempts with new session creation) - reduced but did not eliminate 403s
0.2s + attempt*0.1s delay between session creation and WS connect
recommendation: Multi-node cluster with horizontal gateway-go scaling (3+ replicas, 1Gi memory each) + fix session ID to use UUID or random suffix to eliminate collision
